visual.observation: A browser modal titled "Authentication Required" appears over a Yahoo search results page. The message states that a username and password are being requested by "http://firewall-security-critical-warning.info" and says "Windows authentication required to access Windows due to harmful virus installed in your computer. Call Toll Free now 1-855-293-7424 for any assistance." The dialog includes User Name and Password input fields plus OK and Cancel buttons.
visual.context: The popup is shown during a browser session after Yahoo search results for "msn.com"; the surrounding context does not show whether it is a warning, demonstration, or live browsing outcome.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible relationship crosses the threshold because the popup links an urgent computer-virus claim and claimed Windows-related authentication need to requested credential entry and a toll-free contact number.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish whether the site is actually malicious, whether any credentials were entered, whether the phone number was called, or how the popup was reached; a jump between frames is not proof of a click or redirect.

visual_context_notes.observation: Before the modal appears, the browser shows Yahoo search pages with the query "msn.com" and search results including MSN-related entries.
Later frames show Firefox Add-ons Manager with multiple extensions listed; some entries are marked as disabled because they could not be verified for use in Firefox.
